STEP 1 - Scene: A snack-style meal on a white square-ish plate, photographed from directly overhead (top-down view), with the plate fairly flat and undistorted.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White plate roughly 26 cm across at its widest (the rounded-square plate spans most of the frame). Using 26 cm diameter-equivalent: area = 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Apple (whole, red-yellow, ~7-8 cm diameter)
- Cherry/grape tomatoes (about 6 visible)
- Red grapes (about 5)
- Green grape (1)
- Cooked white rice (small mound)
- Almonds (about 15-20 pieces)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate, total food covers roughly 60%):
- Apple: ~18% (≈95 cm^2)
- Tomatoes: ~12% (≈64 cm^2)
- Grapes (red + green): ~6% (≈32 cm^2)
- Cooked rice: ~9% (≈48 cm^2)
- Almonds: ~9% (≈48 cm^2)
Sum ≈ 54%, consistent with food covering roughly half to most of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume (area x typical height, gross envelope):
- Apple: 95 cm^2 x 6 cm ≈ 570 ml (apple is near-spherical, so use ~8 cm tall envelope in part; take ~300 ml as solid volume for a ~8 cm apple: 4/3·π·4^3 ≈ 268 ml)
- Tomatoes: 64 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 160 ml
- Grapes: 32 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 48 ml
- Rice: 48 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 72 ml
- Almonds: 48 cm^2 x 1 cm ≈ 48 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Apple: 270 ml x 0.6 ≈ 160 g (whole fruit, dense; ~180 g is typical for a medium apple, so use 180 g)
- Tomatoes: 160 ml x 0.6 ≈ 96 g
- Grapes: 48 ml x 0.6 ≈ 29 g
- Rice: 72 ml x 0.8 ≈ 58 g
- Almonds: 48 ml x 0.6 ≈ 29 g (≈ 15-20 almonds at ~1.2 g each is about 20-25 g; use 25 g)

STEP 7 - Energy (kcal/100 g):
- Apple: 180 g x 52 = 94 kcal
- Tomatoes: 96 g x 18 = 17 kcal
- Grapes: 29 g x 69 = 20 kcal
- Rice (cooked): 58 g x 130 = 75 kcal
- Almonds: 25 g x 579 = 145 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 388 g and ≈ 351 kcal. This fits a light, partly covered plate with one apple, a small rice portion, a few tomatoes and grapes, and a modest handful of almonds.
